newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates rise.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Monday in a still short private-sector market to between 8-1/4 and 9-1/2 percent from Sunday's range of eight to 9-1/4 percent, bankers said.
Bankers say the market remains short due to two treasury-bill auctions.
The Central Bank offered 182-day treasury bills worth 1.3 billion pounds ($382.9 million) on Monday against maturity of 927.63 million pounds.
On Wednesday, there will be an auction of 91-day bills worth 1.2 billion pounds against maturity of 761.75 million.
Average one-week rates were between 8-1/8 and 9-1/8 percent from 8-1/4 to nine percent on Sunday.
The bankers said that public-sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
